## `client.deploys`

Queue and follow deploys, dry runs and rollbacks.

### `client.deploys.create`

Signature: `client.deploys.create(environment: str, repository: str, *, kind: str = 'deploy', ref: str | None = None, to_sha: str | None = None, to_previous: bool = False) -> DeployAccepted`

Queue a deploy (needs `DEPLOY` on the environment).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Target environment. |
| `repository` | `str` | required | Registered repository name. |
| `kind` | `str` | `'deploy'` | ``deploy``, ``dry_run`` or ``rollback``. |
| `ref` | `str | None` | `None` | Deploy/dry run: ref or full SHA. |
| `to_sha` | `str | None` | `None` | Rollback: an already-deployed full SHA. |
| `to_previous` | `bool` | `False` | Rollback: the project version current before the present one. |

Returns: `DeployAccepted`. The queued run's id.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.PermissionDenied` | Without `DEPLOY`. |
| `lakana.ValidationError` | For a malformed request. |

### `client.deploys.list`

Signature: `client.deploys.list(environment: str, *, repository: str | None = None, limit: int | None = None, cursor: str | None = None) -> list[Deploy]`

List an environment's deploy history, newest first.

The deploys of one page; `list_page` also returns the cursor of the next one.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `repository` | `str | None` | `None` | Only this repository's deploys. |
| `limit` | `int | None` | `None` | Most deploys returned (1 to 200); `None` leaves it to the server (100). |
| `cursor` | `str | None` | `None` | A previous page's `next_cursor`. Send the same `repository` with every page. |

Returns: `list of Deploy`. Newest first.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If `limit` is outside 1 to 200 or `cursor` is not one the server issued for the deploys list. |

### `client.deploys.list_page`

Signature: `client.deploys.list_page(environment: str, *, repository: str | None = None, limit: int | None = None, cursor: str | None = None) -> DeployPage`

List one page of an environment's deploy history, with the cursor of the next page.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `repository` | `str | None` | `None` | Only this repository's deploys. |
| `limit` | `int | None` | `None` | Most deploys returned (1 to 200); `None` leaves it to the server (100). |
| `cursor` | `str | None` | `None` | A previous page's `next_cursor`. Send the same `repository` with every page. |

Returns: `DeployPage`. The deploys, newest first, and the cursor for the next page (`None` on the last).

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.ValidationError` | If `limit` is outside 1 to 200 or `cursor` is not one the server issued for the deploys list. |

### `client.deploys.wait`

Signature: `client.deploys.wait(environment: str, deploy_id: str, timeout: float | None = None, poll_interval: float = 0.25, max_interval: float = 2.0, on_update: Callable[[Deploy], None] | None = None) -> Deploy`

Poll a run until it succeeds or fails, and until the jobs it starts are started.

A deploy that starts jobs (`on_deploy: true`) is returned only once each start is recorded (no `job_starts` entry is ``pending``), so the result says what became of every job.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `deploy_id` | `str` | required | The run's id. |
| `timeout` | `float | None` | `None` | Seconds to keep polling, or `None` for no limit. |
| `poll_interval` | `float` | `0.25` | First interval, doubling up to `max_interval`. |
| `max_interval` | `float` | `2.0` | Largest interval. |
| `on_update` | `Callable[[Deploy], None] | None` | `None` | Called with every polled `Deploy`, including the last one, before `wait` returns or raises (so a progress display can show why a deploy is `queued`: `deploy.waiting_for`). It is called on every poll, not only when something changed. An exception it raises ends the wait and propagates. `None` (the default) calls nothing. |

Returns: `Deploy`. The run, once `succeeded` and its job starts are recorded.

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.DeployFailed` | If it ends `failed`. |
| `lakana.JobStartsNotRecorded` | If `timeout` elapses after the deploy succeeded, while a job start is still ``pending``; a `TimeoutError` that carries the deploy. |
| `TimeoutError` | If `timeout` elapses before the deploy ends. |

## `client.deployments`

Current project versions per repository.

### `client.deployments.list`

Signature: `client.deployments.list(environment: str) -> list[Deployment]`

List the current project version per repository.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |

Returns: `list of Deployment`. Sorted by repository.

### `client.deployments.set_run_as`

Signature: `client.deployments.set_run_as(environment: str, repository: str, principal: str) -> Deployment`

Bind the service account runs write as (needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT`).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `repository` | `str` | required | Repository name. |
| `principal` | `str` | required | An active service account's name. |

Returns: `Deployment`. The deployment with its binding.

### `client.deployments.clear_run_as`

Signature: `client.deployments.clear_run_as(environment: str, repository: str) -> Deployment`

Remove the run principal binding (needs `MANAGE_ENVIRONMENT`).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `repository` | `str` | required | Repository name. |

Returns: `Deployment`. The deployment without a binding.

### `client.deployments.undeploy`

Signature: `client.deployments.undeploy(environment: str, repository: str) -> None`

Remove a repository's deployment; data stays (needs `DEPLOY`).

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `repository` | `str` | required | Repository name. |

| Error | When |
|---|---|
| `lakana.Conflict` | While a run of the repository is active there. |

## `client.orphans`

Tables earlier project versions produced that current ones do not.

### `client.orphans.list`

Signature: `client.orphans.list(environment: str, *, limit: int | None = None, cursor: str | None = None) -> Orphans`

List one page of the orphans visible to the caller.

An orphan that was dropped and can still be restored is listed with ``exists=False``. `iter` walks every page.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `limit` | `int | None` | `None` | Most orphans returned (1 to 200); `None` leaves it to the server (100). |
| `cursor` | `str | None` | `None` | A previous page's `next_cursor`. |

Returns: `Orphans`. Readable orphans, a hidden count and the cursor of the next page.

### `client.orphans.iter`

Signature: `client.orphans.iter(environment: str, *, page_size: int = 100) -> Iterator[Orphan]`

Yield every orphan visible to the caller, fetching pages as needed.

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `environment` | `str` | required | Environment name. |
| `page_size` | `int` | `100` | Orphans per request (1 to 200). |

Returns: `Iterator of Orphan`. Each orphan, once, in repository and table order.
